title: ConsumableMaster — correctness, data seeds and recompute cost
cluster_summary: Every finding is local to ConsumableMaster. No upstream fix makes any of them moot. Two must-fix bugs: the per-profile macro fingerprint is trusted without reading the live account-wide macro (CM-R-01), and Devourer (12_1480) has no stat-priority seed, so it falls back to AGI with no secondaries (CM-R-02). The per-class seed test that let CM-R-02 through is fixed in the same commit (CM-R-08). Running discovery on spec change (CM-R-04) is a cheap should-fix. The flyout score cache (CM-R-03) is downgraded to low: the mock's nil tooltip makes every call a pending refetch, and in the client TooltipCache memoizes resolved tooltips. The composite-config dedup (CM-R-05) is optional cleanup, since its divergence cannot be reached.

verdicts.assessment: Verified at MacroManager.lua:442-445 and :516: alreadyApplied compares only the per-profile macroState, and returns 'unchanged' before any live read. A deleted macro, or one that another profile overwrote, is therefore never rewritten, which contradicts scope.md and README.
verdicts.remediation: Add liveBody(macroName) using GetMacroIndexByName/GetMacroInfo, and trust the fingerprint only when the live body matches. On a mismatch or a missing macro, fall through to the existing combat-aware write path. Add three tests and a paragraph in docs/macro-manager.md. Add an owner smoke check that the client does not normalize stored bodies.

verdicts.assessment: Defaults_StatPriority.lua seeds only 12_577 and 12_581. Devourer (1480, an Intellect spec) falls back to CLASS_PRIMARY_FALLBACK[12]='AGI' with no secondaries, so every Devourer without an override gets the wrong consumable ranking.
verdicts.remediation: Add ["12_1480"] = { primary = "INT", secondary = <order sourced via the file header's archon.gg refresh procedure> }. If no sourced order is available, ship INT with an empty secondary list, note the gap, and do not guess.

verdicts.assessment: test_defaults.lua:343 asserts per class, not per spec, so it stays green with Devourer missing. It is the gap that let CM-R-02 through, and the fix is cheap.
verdicts.remediation: Land in the same commit as CM-R-02. Iterate a pinned list of the playable classID_specID keys (excluding Initial specs), with a '-- red under:' comment naming the removal of 12_1480.

verdicts.assessment: Verified that KCM:OnSpecChanged (ConsumableMaster.lua:767-776) only calls requestRecompute. Discovery is filed per spec, so the new spec's bucket misses unseeded bag items until the next bag event. It heals itself, but the fix is a single call.
verdicts.remediation: Call runAutoDiscovery("spec_changed") before requestRecompute in KCM:OnSpecChanged. Add a pipeline test and update the event row in docs/data-flow.md.

verdicts.assessment: Structurally true: each flyout re-scores through ListAvailable with no scoreCache. The magnitude is a mock artifact, though. wow_mock.lua:1003 returns nil from GetItemByID, so TooltipCache.Get stores a pending stub and refetches on every call. In the client, resolved tooltips are memoized (TooltipCache.lua:436-485). What remains is out-of-combat re-scoring and GetItemInfo churn, with no frame-time evidence.
verdicts.remediation: Defer unless a perf-analysis capture shows recompute frame time that matters. If done: build one scoreCache per out-of-combat MB.Refresh, thread it through FO.Apply -> FO.Candidates -> Selector.ListAvailable, and test one scoring pass per candidate per refresh (not one tooltip parse). Any perf figure needs a mock that returns real tooltip lines.

verdicts.assessment: There are two copies of the composite config rule. Their divergence on a missing bucket cannot be reached under AceDB defaults, and compositeRefs is at CCN 15 (at the threshold, not over it), so players see no effect.
verdicts.remediation: Do this only if compositeRefs is touched for another reason or would exceed CCN 15. Write a characterization test first, then publish MacroManager.CompositeConfig and have Selector.compositeRefs delegate to it.
